name: code-quality-suite
description: Code-quality and security audit with up to nine parallel read-only reviewers (standards, duplication, logging, secrets, tests, dependencies, plus code-level vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), attacker's-eye exploitable loopholes, and an OWASP ASVS gap analysis) that produces a color-coded HTML/PDF report with a health score, attack scenarios and an effort-sized fix plan, plus a passive read-only live-site health check (TLS, security headers, cookies, HTTP->HTTPS redirect).
